historicalW6Contribution.rootCause: The original SQL matrices seeded worker phases and reused a fixed fence. Real worker R20 demonstrated two additional production failures: deferObservation cleared the accepted native-task lease but PLATFORM_PENDING was constrained to always hold one; and a governed retry acquired a new fence then attempted APPLY using the preceding fence readback, correctly failing strict retry proof. The earlier known-task STATUS timeout orchestration also discarded its addressable observation path.
historicalW6Contribution.implementedBehavior: Only inconclusive STATUS_ENQUIRY for an accepted addressable native Task defers another read-only poll. Idle PLATFORM_PENDING may have no lease, but every transport open/complete still checks the active lease and fence, and defer cannot release an IN_FLIGHT attempt. A RETRY_WAIT lease alone sets private retry_preflight_fence to its incremented fence; the worker must READBACK under this new lease. Only fresh MATCHES_PRIOR plus the unchanged strict retry proof, budget, delay and live gate can enter EXECUTING; that transition consumes the marker. New-fence target completes without APPLY, third value investigates, unreadable becomes Unknown. Marker clears on released/terminal phases; an expired retry preflight becomes Unknown while an expired first-apply lease returns Pending.
proofLimits: R20 executed the old four worker scenarios: two negative paths passed and both positive retry paths failed at actual lease/fence boundaries. R21 then executed all nine current scenarios with zero failure/error/skip, including the same two previously failing positive methods and the new-fence/readback/recovery controls. This establishes the scoped repair on the archived R21 source, not a final clean/CI verdict or an overall passing R21 batch.

Protocol bytes, fictional transport registry and initial approved control graph are synthetic. Actual command creation, Java worker transitions, leases, durable attempts, Raw custody, frozen classification and readback/retry gates are production implementations; no f.state is used to advance these worker scenarios.
The two lease-recovery tests explicitly inject only lease_expires_at using the migration fixture after an actual lease; they prove actual recovery routing, not a real process crash or network outage.
Resolved SUCCESS plus prior supports the existing safe native-idempotent reentry rule; it does not prove the earlier APPLY never occurred.

Fine-grained stale approval, native unit, credential, gate-envelope and adversarial completion matrices remain separately bound to actual SQL RetryProofIT/MinimumExpiryIT/ActorRevocationIT. These nine tests supplement, not replace, those matrix proofs.
